sources.title: peculiar-ragdoll/Cyber-Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B-MLX-oQ6e-MTP · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We measured the full grid — both model families (TielCoder, CyberTiel) x both quants (oQ4e, oQ6e) x MTP vs non-MTP, on oMLX and LM Studio. Every -MTP MLX build garbles in LM Studio; every non-MTP build is clean; oMLX runs all eight correctly. The weights are fine — the runtime is not.

sources.title: peculiar-ragdoll/Cyber-Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The part of speed that is not hardware dependent is the model's ability to converge quickly on a correct solution and deliver it, and this — in combination with chat template tricks — is Tiel's main speed advantage against the other 35B-A3B models.

sources.title: Cyber-Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B-GGUF-MTP: Text-to-Text model — overview, use ...
sources.snippet: Overview Cyber-Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B-GGUF-MTP is a text-to-text, code-focused Mixture-of-Experts model distributed in GGUF format and maintained by peculiar-ragdoll. It is based on Huihui-Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-abliterated, which derives from Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, and combines dynamic re-quantization with a cyber-weighted importance matrix, the Sharp chat template, and a grafted multi-token-prediction ...
